description: List groups a specific Zendesk user belongs to, with page and per-page parameters, optional exclusion of deleted groups, and sorting. Use it to audit team memberships or retrieve a user's support groups.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing groups for a specific Zendesk user.

exclude_deleted.description: Whether to exclude deleted groups from the response.
exclude_deleted.title: Exclude Deleted

include_boundary_indicators.description: When true, includes `has_more` indicator in the cursor pagination response meta. Only valid with cursor pagination (page[size], page[after], page[before]).
include_boundary_indicators.title: Include Boundary Indicators

include_item_cursors.description: When true, includes cursor values for each item in the cursor pagination response. Only valid with cursor pagination (page[size], page[after], page[before]).
include_item_cursors.title: Include Item Cursors

page.description: Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination: traditional uses `?page=2` (integer page number); cursor uses `?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor`. These are mutually exclusive.
page.title: Page

per_page.description: Number of records to return per page. Default and maximum values vary by endpoint.
per_page.title: Per Page

sort.description: Field to sort results by. Prefix with `-` for descending order. Example: `?sort=name` or `?sort=-created_at`
sort.title: Sort

user_id.description: The numeric ID of the user. Returns groups that this user belongs to.
user_id.title: User Id

inputSchema.title: GetUsersGroupsRequest

name: get_users_groups

GetUsersGroupsResponse.description: Response containing list of groups for a Zendesk user.

after_cursor.description: Cursor for next page (cursor pagination only)
after_cursor.title: After Cursor

before_cursor.description: Cursor for previous page (cursor pagination only)
before_cursor.title: Before Cursor

count.description: Total count of groups (offset pagination only)
count.title: Count

groups.description: List of groups the user belongs to
groups.title: Groups

has_more.description: Whether more results are available (cursor pagination only)
has_more.title: Has More

next_page.description: URL for next page of results (offset pagination)
next_page.title: Next Page

previous_page.description: URL for previous page of results (offset pagination)
previous_page.title: Previous Page

GetUsersGroupsResponse.title: GetUsersGroupsResponse

created_at.description: Timestamp when the group was created
created_at.title: Created At

default.description: Whether this is the default group
default.title: Default

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the group was last updated
updated_at.title: Updated At
